answer_1.quote: Text Style Transfer aims to alter the style of input text x to produce output text y while preserving the original content.
answer_1.outputs: style-converted text outputs preserving original content

answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to assess attribute control, such as style accuracy (ACC) and content preservation (CP) after transfer.

answer_4.quote: To supplement automatic metrics, we conducted human evaluations by sampling 50 instances from each dataset. Five participants were enlisted to assess each model based on three criteria: (1) strength of style transfer, (2) semantic integrity, and (3) sentence fluidity.
answer_4.guideline: Participants assessed each model based on three criteria: (1) strength of style transfer, (2) semantic integrity, and (3) sentence fluidity.
